title: A programme with a purpose.
deck: Albion News began as a way to help the club survive.
body: The club traces the birth of The Albion News & Official Programme to the opening home match of the 1905 season, against Burnley. It followed a period of serious financial pressure and the destruction of the old “Noah’s Ark” stand by fire.

The programme offered a regular new source of income. That origin gives a familiar matchday object a different meaning: something bought to read before kick-off was also part of an effort to sustain the club. The type treatment here is a modern interpretation, not a scan of the 1905 issue.
